evidenceLabels.measured: destructive harvest fresh weight (g) at 2024-10-03; morphology; SPAD
evidenceLabels.derived: group means, permutation tests, bootstrap intervals, implied Ky
evidenceLabels.notUsed: non-destructive fresh weight from regression analysis (modelled, not measured) - present in the export, deliberately excluded from estimates

irrigationContrast.comparison: 75 % vs 50 % application rate, Grand Rapid only (unbalanced design)
irrigationContrast.permutationPNote: a Monte Carlo permutation test cannot resolve below 1/(draws+1); a reported value at the floor means no permuted sample reached the observed difference
irrigationContrast.interpretation: the difference is not distinguishable from zero, so at this application contrast there is no measurable yield penalty

cultivarContrast.comparison: Grand Rapid vs Lollo Rossa at 75 % application rate
cultivarContrast.permutationPNote: a Monte Carlo permutation test cannot resolve below 1/(draws+1); a reported value at the floor means no permuted sample reached the observed difference
cultivarContrast.interpretation: a single parameter set for 'lettuce' cannot represent both cultivars: the same treatments produce a yield ratio of about 1.8

kyAccounting.whyConditional: no per-treatment evapotranspiration was measured; the application rate is an irrigation design variable, not water use

scenarios.assumedBasis: nominal design ratio (50/75); not a measurement
